Community Promotion Commission, July 8, 2024  Page 2 of 2
   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  JUNE 10, 2024

Vice Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:04 p.m. Responding to roll call were Commissioner
Beacham and Commissioner Sanchez. Chair Leon arrived late. Also present was Levy Sun, Director
of Communications and Public Affairs, Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior Management Analyst and Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Beacham made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the
minutes for May 20, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Commissioner’s Meet & Greet Event

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners for their feedback on the event and suggested moving the event
to a larger room. Vice Chair Ang thanked staff for their efforts in organizing the event and stated that
a PA system will be needed next year and suggested assigning commissioners to tables. Commissioner
Beacham also thanked staff for their support and appreciated the department presenters.
Commissioner Beacham suggested having commissioners pick a number when they arrive and that
would be their seat assignment to promote the mix and mingle portion. Chair Leon thanked Vice Chair
Ang for his assistance in announcer duties. Chair Leon recommended having the mix and mingle at
the beginning of the event and set a timer to keep the event on track. Chair Leon also suggested
having two department presentations instead of three but would like to keep Community Development
as one of the two presenters.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the May Barber Shops edition video to
Commissioners. Mr. Sun provided Commissioners with a Business Spotlight Guidelines draft and
explained its purpose. Commissioner Beacham suggested having the city attorney review the
document. Chair Leon asked if there is a payment limit when purchasing items for filming. Mrs.
Ocegueda confirmed that there currently is no limit and the maximum she’s spent is thirty-five dollars.
Mrs. Ocegueda explained that she only purchases one item for the businesses coming in at 3rd and 2nd
place, and two items for the business placing 1st. Chair Leon asked to put a $50 spending limit for each
business, per campaign. Mr. Sun agreed to send the draft to legal counsel to review and will bring this
item back to the Commission.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Commissioner Beacham looks forward
to seeing if the Inaugural 5K Run will increase the positivity of engagement for the month of June.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
June 10, 2024

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioner Sanchez if he had any updates on the date for the Annual Arturo
Sanchez Sr. Halloween Parade. Commissioner Sanchez responded that a date has not been
established yet but will relay the information as soon as he knows the date.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez provided positive compliments about the 5K Run. Chair Leon agreed with
Commissioner Sanchez’s comments regarding the 5K Run but explained she received feedback from
participants asking that the zig zag portion of the route be eliminated and change it to have participants
run thru the neighborhood streets instead. Chair Leon also suggested the live performance band play
as participants are arriving for the event instead of after the runner awards are given as many people
decide to leave immediately after their run is finished.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:27 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
